sync-chain:s0.title: 4 requests deep
sync-chain:s0.message: s0 → s1 → s2 → s3 → s4: each waits for the next, so all 5 must be up, and their latencies add up. Making the last call a message means s0 no longer waits for s4.
sync-chain:s0.rationale: Each synchronous hop multiplies availability and adds latency: a request succeeds only when every service it waits on does. Turning a call into a message lets the caller finish without waiting.
